section-29-1.FOR: A person (a “service-provider”) concerned with the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public (for payment or not)
section-29-1.TO: discriminate against a person requiring the service by not providing the person with the service

section-29-2.TO: discriminate against a person (B)— (a) as to the terms on which A provides the service to B; (b) by terminating the provision of the service to B; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment

section-29-3.TO: harass— (a) a person requiring the service, or (b) a person to whom the service-provider provides the service

section-29-4.TO: victimise a person requiring the service by not providing the person with the service

section-29-5.TO: victimise a person (B)— (a) as to the terms on which A provides the service to B; (b) by terminating the provision of the service to B; (c) by subjecting B to any other detriment

section-29-6.TO: do anything that constitutes discrimination, harassment or victimisation
section-29-6.IN: the exercise of a public function that is not the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public

section-29-7.FOR: — (a) a service-provider (and see also section 55(7)); (b) a person who exercises a public function that is not the provision of a service to the public or a section of the public
